falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A 77% bottom_2024_aug pattern match with a blowoff score of 39 suggests a near-term low is forming; a break below 4,800 would violate the structural support expected in this pattern and indicate the bottoming process has failed, invalidating the HOLD signal as a stabilization call

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 39 implies moderate but not extreme stress; sustained VIX above 35 would indicate panic escalation beyond what the pattern allows, showing the market is entering a liquidation phase rather than the expected consolidation/bottom formation, making the pattern match irrelevant

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rapid rates collapse of this magnitude would signal a deflationary or systemic fear shock (flight-to-safety), which is inconsistent with the bottom_2024_aug pattern that occurred during a gradual economic slowdown; this would prove the macro regime has shifted to crisis mode, invalidating the pattern-based stabilization verdict

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
